name: NUTTERX-MD
description: WhatsApp bot (Baileys) with a pairing web server. The WhatsApp session is stored in Heroku Postgres so it survives restarts.

SESSION_ID.description: Your NUTTERX~ session ID from the pairing page. Only used the first time; after that the session lives in the database.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Optional. Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 2547XXXXXXXX). Comma-separate several numbers.

MODE.description: public (everyone can use commands) or private (owner only).
